notes: Primary replication DOCX verified against Chung & Chuwonganant (2014) citation and study title. Input provides no outcome/test locator; replication report explicitly identifies its single focal original claim. Extracted printed coefficient rather than requested d. Replication report labels 2,142 observations in power section but identifies these as firms and coefficient estimates in paragraphs 77 and 82. Reported mean/median individual t-statistics and p-values in paragraphs 37 and 40 are different summaries and are not paired with the focal coefficient test. Because the assigned input has no description, study identifier, or test locator, target match for the replication is unknown: values describe the report’s explicitly selected focal test and cannot be confirmed as the specific intended audit effect. Original-paper statistics quoted in the replication report were not substituted for original-paper verification.
